defs.AddWho:
/** Whom the network lets this account add to a group. friends: only its friends (Discord group DMs). contacts: people */
type AddWho = "friends" | "contacts" | "known";
defs.AppChoiceFact: type AppChoiceFact = { name: string; value: string | number };
defs.AppCommandKind:
/** chat: typed after a slash; message: run on a message (its Apps menu); user: run on a person. */
type AppCommandKind = "chat" | "message" | "user";
defs.AppOptionType:
/** What an option takes. */
type AppOptionType = "string"
| "number"
| "boolean"
| "user"
| "role"
| "channel"
| "integer"
| "mentionable"
| "attachment";
defs.AppOptionValue:
/** An option's value as the owner gave it. `ref`: the value is a native id of that kind (a person, a role, a channel); */
type AppOptionValue = { name: string; value: string | number | boolean; ref?: "user" | "role" | "channel" };
defs.AttentionKind:
/** Why an account needs a human. Drives the "Needs you" cards. */
type AttentionKind = "verify" | "captcha" | "login" | "link_device" | "selector_broken" | "rate_limited" | "unknown";
defs.CallMode:
/** Voice calls. Two ways to carry one, so they can be compared: */
type CallMode = "bridge" | "direct";
defs.CustomEmojiFact:
/** A custom emoji. Reactions refer to it by key; the hub keeps a catalog per network. */
type CustomEmojiFact = { key: string; name: string; url: string; animated?: boolean };
defs.EventStatus:
/** scheduled: not started; active: on now; completed: over; cancelled: called off. */
type EventStatus = "scheduled" | "active" | "completed" | "cancelled";
defs.HistoryVisibility:
/** Matrix: who can read the history. */
type HistoryVisibility = "world_readable" | "shared" | "invited" | "joined";
defs.InteractionState:
/** sending: on its way, nothing back yet. answered: the bot answered (it changed the message, replied, or said it is */
type InteractionState = "modal" | "failed" | "answered" | "sending" | "timedOut";
defs.JoinRule:
/** How people get in. open: anyone who finds it or has the link. invite: only those invited. ask: they ask, a member */
type JoinRule = "space" | "invite" | "open" | "ask";
defs.ModPower:
/** One power over members here: whether this account may use it, and why not in words. */
type ModPower = { can: boolean; reason?: string };
defs.Network:
/** The dither-chat ontology: one vocabulary for Discord, Signal, Matrix and WhatsApp. */
type Network = "discord"
| "signal"
| "matrix"
| "whatsapp"
| "telegram"
| "gmessages"
| "messenger"
| "instagram"
| "x"
| "email"
| "calendar"
| "t3";
defs.PersonRelationship:
/** friend: accepted; requested: you asked them; requesting: they asked you; contact: in your address book. */
type PersonRelationship = "friend" | "requested" | "requesting" | "blocked" | "contact" | "following" | "stranger";
defs.PollDraft:
/** A poll to make. `hours`: how long it stays open, one of POLL_RULES' choices, where the network has them. */
type PollDraft = { question: string; options: string[]; multi: boolean; hours?: number };
defs.PollVoteFact:
/** One voter's whole vote: the options they hold now ([] took it back). `seq`: Signal's vote count; the highest wins. */
type PollVoteFact = { voter: string; options: string[]; seq: number; ts?: number };
defs.PostAct:
/** Done to a post (capability 'postActions', the `postAct` command). */
type PostAct = "like" | "repost" | "unlike" | "unrepost";
defs.PostMedia:
/** A picture or video in a post. `url` is the full picture (for a video, its poster frame). */
type PostMedia = { kind: "image" | "video" | "gif"; url: string; width?: number; height?: number; alt?: string };
defs.PostViewer:
/** What you have done to a post. */
type PostViewer = { liked?: boolean; reposted?: boolean };
defs.PresenceChange:
/** What `setPresence` changes. A field left out stays as it is; `status: null` clears the status line. */
type PresenceChange = { state?: "online" | "idle" | "dnd" | "invisible"; status?: null | OwnStatus };
defs.ProfileField:
/** What `setProfile` may change: the bio, the profile name, the emoji by the bio, the picture, the username, pronouns, the banner and its colour. */
type ProfileField = "emoji" | "name" | "avatar" | "bio" | "username" | "pronouns" | "banner" | "accent";
defs.ReceiptState:
/** How far a message got with someone: their device has it, they read it, they played it (a voice note, a video). */
type ReceiptState = "read" | "delivered" | "played";
defs.SelectKind:
/** What a select picks from: options the bot listed, or people, roles, either, or channels of the place. */
type SelectKind = "string" | "user" | "role" | "channel" | "mentionable";
defs.SelfFact:
/** A setting as a line to show: "Direct messages from server members": "Allowed, except in 2 servers". */
type SelfFact = { label: string; value: string };
defs.Shape:
/** Where a conversation sits in the social structure, independent of network. */
type Shape = "group" | "channel" | "direct" | "thread" | "self";
defs.SpaceKind:
/** community: something you join and that has its own membership and moderation */
type SpaceKind = "community" | "section";
defs.StageAction:
/** What a stage asks of you or a moderator: put your own hand up or down; speak (taking a moderator's invitation, or */
type StageAction = "invite" | "raiseHand" | "lowerHand" | "speak" | "listen" | "audience";
defs.StickerSource:
/** Where a pack comes from: a server's own stickers, the network's standard packs, or packs installed on the account. */
type StickerSource = "server" | "standard" | "installed";
defs.VoiceFact:
/** A voice message: how long it lasts and its waveform, one byte (0 to 255) per point, as base64. */
type VoiceFact = { seconds?: number; waveform?: string };
defs.VoiceOut:
/** A recorded voice message: its length and Discord's waveform (base64 of up to 256 bytes, one each tenth of a second, */
type VoiceOut = { seconds: number; waveform?: string };
defs.Who:
/** Who may do something, as far as the networks agree. */
type Who = "admins" | "everyone";
